name: Web Tools
description: Built-in web tools for the agent: multi-provider web_search, web_fetch (with readable text extraction), web_download, and web_research.
author: cognia-next

networkAccess.reasoning: web_search, web_fetch, web_download and web_research operate on URLs the user or agent supplies at runtime, so any host may be reached. The user's search-provider keys are only sent to their configured providers.
